newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-PRIMEAU FINED $1,000 AND SUSPENDED FOR A SECOND GAME.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-PRIMEAU FINED $1,000 AND SUSPENDED FOR A SECOND GAME.

text.p: Hartford Whalers centre Keith Primeau, who sat out Thursday's game against the Boston Bruins, was fined $1,000 and suspended for a second game without pay by the National Hockey League on Friday.

Following a hearing into the New Year's Day game slashing incident against Joe Juneau of the Washington Capitals, the NHL imposed an additional game's punishment of Primeau, who sat out a 5-4 overtime loss to the Bruins on Thursday.
Primeau will miss Hartford's game Saturday against the Washington Capitals.
Juneau is expected to miss two weeks with a severe bruise on his left shoulder caused by Primeau's heavy slash.

"Mr. Primeau retaliated against a trip by Mr. Juneau by slashing him in the shoulder," NHL senior vice president and director of hockey operations Brian Burke said. "The use of a two-handed baseball grip by any player will not be tolerated."
